hypothesis: A reproducible malignant residual program emerges within persistent TNBC clones
supporting_evidence: Kim 2018 reports pre-existing genotypes with acquired transcriptional profiles
contradictory_or_limiting_evidence: Small cohort and older snRNA platform; apparent emergence may be nondetection
assumptions: RNA-inferred or scDNA clones approximate lineage
test: Within CNA clone compare locked program scores across time and patients
expected_if_true: Consistent post-treatment gain after stress/cell-cycle adjustment
alternative_explanation: Generic stress or sampling different regions
falsification_criterion: No independent post-treatment enrichment or effect disappears under confounder controls

hypothesis: Pretreatment abundance of the residual program predicts residual disease
supporting_evidence: Large ARTEMIS cohort links pretreatment metaprograms/ecotypes to pCR/RD
contradictory_or_limiting_evidence: This broad question is already substantially addressed by Yan 2026
test: Lock discovery program then patient-level response test in ARTEMIS
alternative_explanation: Tumour purity or depth drives score
falsification_criterion: Association is null/reversed after prespecified covariates

hypothesis: Selection and plasticity contributions vary reproducibly across patients
supporting_evidence: Kim 2018 and PDX time series support both genomic and nongenomic mechanisms
contradictory_or_limiting_evidence: Sparse sampling makes quantitative decomposition weakly identifiable
test: Depth-matched occupancy and within-clone score-change decomposition
expected_if_true: Nonzero contributions of both mechanisms with reproducible patient strata
alternative_explanation: Undetected rare states masquerade as induction
falsification_criterion: Estimates are unstable to depth/state definition or fail external replication

hypothesis: Spatial macrophage/ECM niches constrain residual malignant programs
supporting_evidence: Yan 2026 links Mac-ECM/Mac-angio with hypoxia/EMT programs and RD
contradictory_or_limiting_evidence: Pretreatment spatial association cannot establish future constraint
test: Locked neighborhood enrichment in independent spatial residual cohort
expected_if_true: Residual program preferentially neighbors prespecified niche
falsification_criterion: No enrichment in held-out cohort or signal vanishes with spatial null
